stdout:
GridGrind <version>
Structured .xlsx workbook automation engine with an agent-friendly JSON protocol

Workflows:
  Discover:
    List recipes:
      gridgrind recipe list
    Match a goal:
      gridgrind recipe match "monthly dashboard"
    Find protocol capabilities:
      gridgrind catalog search "chart title"
    Inspect an exact shape:
      gridgrind catalog show mutationActionTypes:SET_CELL
  Prepare and authorize:
    Create a request:
      gridgrind recipe show BUDGET --response budget-request.json
    Create fail-closed authority:
      gridgrind template grant --response grant.json
    Edit the grant to authorize the request's exact resources, targets and publication.
    Diagnose:
      gridgrind doctor --request budget-request.json --grant grant.json
  Execute:
    Run:
      gridgrind run --request budget-request.json --grant grant.json --response
      response.json
    Materialize asset-backed recipes into a new workspace before execution.
    Inspect the structured result, warnings, assertions and publication outcome.

Standard input:
  gridgrind run --request - --execution-root . --grant grant.json < request.json

  The request document and STANDARD_INPUT payloads cannot consume the same stream.

Docker Example:
  docker run --rm -i \
    --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" \
    -v "$(pwd)":/work \
    ghcr.io/resoltico/gridgrind:latest \
    run --request request.json \
    --grant grant.json \
    --response response.json

  Mount the host working directory at /work and rely on the image's prepared WORKDIR so
  relative CLI paths resolve inside that mounted directory without a separate -w
  override. Pass --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" on ordinary bind mounts so response and
  workbook files stay owned by the calling host user; omit it only when Docker Desktop
  or a rootless runtime already remaps bind-mount ownership for you. From a repository
  checkout, build the same runtime surface with 'docker buildx build --load -t
  gridgrind-local .' and replace ghcr.io/resoltico/gridgrind:latest with
  'gridgrind-local'.

Discovery:
  Discovery commands:
    gridgrind recipe list
    gridgrind recipe show BUDGET --response budget-request.json
    gridgrind recipe match "monthly sales dashboard with charts"
    gridgrind recipe materialize CUSTOM_XML --workspace custom-xml
    gridgrind catalog search "chart title"
    gridgrind schema request --response request.schema.json
  Unified recipe catalog entries:
    - PIVOT (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: pivot-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Pivot authoring from a contiguous range with pivot readback and health
        analysis.
    - CHART (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: chart-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Supported chart authoring with named-range-backed series and factual
        chart readback.
    - CUSTOM_XML (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: custom-xml-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Repo-asset-backed existing-workbook custom-XML mapping discovery, XML
        export, and file-backed XML import.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: custom-xml-assets/custom-xml-mapping.xlsx,
        custom-xml-assets/custom-xml-update.xml
    - SHEET_MAINTENANCE (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: sheet-maintenance-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Copy-sheet maintenance walkthrough with comment reread and workbook
        findings.
    - WORKBOOK_HEALTH (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: workbook-health-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Compact no-save workbook-health pass with targeted formula and aggregate
        findings.
    - ARRAY_FORMULA (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: array-formula-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Array-formula authoring with factual group readback and group clearing.
    - BUDGET (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: budget-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Selector-first budget sheet with styling, formula totals, readback, and
        schema inspection.
    - FILE_HYPERLINK_HEALTH (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: file-hyperlink-health-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Request-asset text plus workbook-relative file and document hyperlink
        analysis.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: file-hyperlink-assets/request-label.txt
    - LARGE_FILE_MODES (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: large-file-modes-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Low-memory STREAMING_WRITE plan with append-only rows and recalc-on-open
        flagging.
    - INTROSPECTION_ANALYSIS (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: introspection-analysis-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Batch factual reads plus formula, hyperlink, named-range, and aggregate
        workbook analysis.
    - PACKAGE_SECURITY_INSPECTION (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: package-security-inspect-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Repo-asset-backed encrypted package open plus factual package-security
        and cell inspection.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: package-security-assets/gridgrind-package-security.xlsx
    - SIGNATURE_LINE (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: signature-line-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Signature-line authoring with drawing-object readback and authored anchor
        replacement.
    - ASSERTION (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: assertion-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Mutate then verify with first-class assertions, verbose journaling, and
        factual readback.
    - SOURCE_BACKED_INPUT (EXAMPLE)
      requestFileName: source-backed-input-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Repo-asset-backed file text, formula, and binary payload authoring
        without large inline literals.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: source-backed-input-assets/title.txt,
        source-backed-input-assets/total-formula.txt,
        source-backed-input-assets/payload.bin
    - TABULAR_REPORT (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: tabular-report-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Create a structured worksheet report with typed cells, table semantics,
        and factual readback.
    - DASHBOARD (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: dashboard-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Assemble an executive dashboard from reusable named surfaces and
        supported charts.
    - DATA_ENTRY_WORKFLOW (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: data-entry-workflow-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Build one repeatable intake worksheet for row-oriented data entry with
        validations, comments, and later factual inspection.
    - PIVOT_REPORT (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: pivot-report-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Create one pivot-ready report flow from source data through named tables
        and pivot-table inspection.
    - AUDIT_EXISTING_WORKBOOK (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: audit-existing-workbook-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Inspect an existing workbook, surface health findings, and avoid mutation
        unless a follow-up workflow explicitly asks for it.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: task-starter-assets/workbook-ops-source.xlsx
    - CUSTOM_XML_WORKFLOW (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: custom-xml-workflow-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Inspect, export, and import existing workbook custom-XML mappings on
        mapped .xlsx files.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: custom-xml-assets/custom-xml-mapping.xlsx,
        custom-xml-assets/custom-xml-update.xml
    - DRAWING_AND_SIGNATURE_WORKFLOW (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: drawing-and-signature-workflow-request.json
      advisory: SELF_CONTAINED
      summary: Author or inspect drawing-backed workbook content such as signature
        lines, pictures, shapes, and embedded objects.
    - WORKBOOK_MAINTENANCE (TASK_STARTER)
      requestFileName: workbook-maintenance-request.json
      advisory: REQUIRES_EXAMPLE_ASSETS
      summary: Safely copy or normalize existing workbook sheets while verifying
        comments, drawings, and other cloned workbook state after the change.
      requiredWorkspacePaths: task-starter-assets/workbook-ops-source.xlsx
  Print one recipe:
    gridgrind recipe show DASHBOARD --response recipe.json
  Materialize one asset-backed recipe:
    gridgrind recipe materialize CUSTOM_XML --workspace custom-xml
  Advisory notes:
    - Portability.
      SELF_CONTAINED recipes run from a blank workspace.
      Recipes with requiredWorkspacePaths must be materialized into a new workspace.
      Recipe and task metadata are also available through the core discovery API.
    - Protocol.
      Catalog search returns summary-first matches; catalog show returns exact fields
      and constraints.
      Use qualified group:id values when an ID appears in more than one group.
      Use schema request, schema grant and schema response for the exchanged documents.

Docs:
  Quick reference: https://github.com/resoltico/GridGrind/blob/main/docs/QUICK_REFERENCE.md
    Synopsis-first command cheat sheet for first-contact lookup.
  Operations reference: https://github.com/resoltico/GridGrind/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md
    Longer operator workflows, artifact handling, and runtime/container use.
  Error reference: https://github.com/resoltico/GridGrind/blob/main/docs/ERRORS.md
    Problem codes, failure interpretation, and recovery guidance.
